statement: The limit S(p) = limN→∞ SN (p) exists and is uniform over all nonnegative nondecreasing profiles bounded by any fixed constant. For a finite-step profile without residual diagonal, put ∆pj = pj − pj−1, I = k X j=1 mj−1∆pj, λj = b − k X i=j+1 mi−1∆pi (0 ≤ j ≤ k). Thus λk = b, λ0 = b − I, and λj−1 = λj − mj−1∆pj. Define, for b > I, X(b) = − 1 2 log b + p0 2λ0 + k X j=1 1 2mj−1 log λj λj−1 . (2.9) There is exactly one b > I satisfying −2X′ (b) = 1 b + p0 λ2 0 + k X j=1 pj − pj−1 λjλj−1 = 1. (2.10) At this value of b, S(p) = X(b) + b 2 − 1 2 − pk 2 . (2.11) If p ≤ B, its saddle point satisfies 1 ≤ b < 2(B + 1).
